description: Debug agent discovery workflow - scans codebase for potential bugs, error-prone patterns, race conditions, memory leaks, and logic errors.
author: ProjectZeroDays (All-Knowing Deity)

steps.description: Scan entire codebase for common bug patterns, logic errors, race conditions, deadlocks, memory leaks, null pointer dereferences, and unhandled exceptions
steps.action: Static analysis of all source files to identify potential bugs, race conditions, memory leaks, and error-prone patterns

steps.description: Analyze existing error logs, stack traces, and crash reports to identify recurring failure patterns
steps.action: Parse existing error logs, correlate stack traces with source code, identify recurring failure patterns

steps.description: Prioritize bugs by severity, frequency, and impact on system stability
steps.action: Prioritize bugs by severity, frequency, and impact on system stability
